A robust customer and partner network, that will act as a spring board for success. Strong technical aptitude to hold credibility—the "challenger" approach—with highly technical security buyers. Ideal candidate located in one of the major metro areas in Texas Who You Are Unrelenting Hunter: You are persistent in prospecting and do not get discouraged by rejection. Scrappy & Resourceful: You make a big impact with lean resources and have the hustle to try different channels until you get traction. Tactful Operator: You are highly skilled in navigating sensitive stakeholder discussions and complex negotiations. Smart & Intuitive: You are quick on your feet, can grasp technical nuances, and instantly adapt your messaging to the room. Location: Ideal candidate located in one of the major metro areas in Texas Why Lema This is an opportunity to solve the largest persisting problem in cybersecurity at the exact moment product-market fit is proven and scale begins. Lema AI is changing the face of TPRM and adapting it to the reality of the modern vendor ecosystem.
